description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4} in four different colors of mana.
Wildgrowth Archaic triggers, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter with four +1/+1 counters on it. It'll enter with a total of eight counters due to its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{W}{W}{U}{B}{R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
